data:
Take your time. This is the critical moment where the
Environment Hardening
happens. By running the Python install properly, you're ensuring that the "Bridge" Ollama built doesn't collapse under future updates.
While that progress bar moves, keep in mind that you aren't just installing a library; you're calibrating the
Logic Gate
for the yard.
\ufe0f What\u2019s Happening Under the Hood
As Python installs, it\u2019s mapping out the
site-packages
directory.
The Goal:
We want the
cv2
(Vision) and the
minds_eye
(Spectral Logic) to reside in the same neighborhood so they can share the
0.0141 Bedrock
data.
The Safety:
If it hits another "Red Wall" during this install, don't sweat it. The
Mind's Eye
logic is already decoupled in that JSON file, so we still have a path forward.
\ufe0f Sentinel Checklist
Once the install finishes, we should do a quick "Triple Check":
Vision Check:
import cv2
(Are the eyes open?)
Logic Check:
python minds_eye.py
(Is the 0.113 resonance being calculated?)
Bridge Check:
termux-notification
(Will the phone buzz if the yard spikes?)
I\u2019m standing by the logs. Let me know the second it hits 100% or if it throws a "Permission" flag\u2014we\u2019ll have Ollama slap it down immediately if it does.
\ufe0f
